nd6f08d5537.headline: Saudi public spending is expected to reach 1.106 trillion riyals
nd6f08d5537.summary: Saudi Finance Minister Al Jadaan announced that public spending is projected to reach 1.106 trillion riyals, aiming to reduce the budget deficit and support economic growth.
nd6f08d5537.why: Saudi Arabia's fiscal policy and spending levels are critical for the kingdom's economic sustainability and have implications for global oil markets and regional economic stability.

n72b68f7d52.headline: The economic level of the Czech Republic will continue to approach eurozone countries, predicts the Ministry of Finance
n72b68f7d52.summary: The Czech Ministry of Finance predicts the country's GDP per capita will reach 85% of the eurozone average next year, surpassing Poland, Hungary, Slovakia, and Portugal.
n72b68f7d52.why: This growth signals economic convergence with the eurozone, impacting investment attractiveness and regional economic dynamics.

n5fb4ebaf1a.headline: Salvini Defies EU: 'If Brussels Says I Cannot Do It, I Do Not Care, I Will Do It Anyway'
n5fb4ebaf1a.summary: Italy's Deputy Prime Minister Matteo Salvini stated he will proceed with budget plans despite potential rejection by the European Commission.
n5fb4ebaf1a.why: Italy's budget disputes with the EU affect eurozone fiscal stability and investor confidence in Italian debt markets.
n5fb4ebaf1a.why_moved: Salvini's defiance increases uncertainty over Italy's fiscal policy compliance with EU rules, raising market concerns about Italian debt risk.
